prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Celia thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just heard the municipal pool is being permanently shut down because the water is so toxic it’s an absolute death trap. Old Mr. Henderson said he saw 14 city inspectors in hazmat suits there yesterday, so it really is a confirmed health disaster."
text: The municipal pool is being permanently boarded up because the water has turned into a toxic, lethal death trap. Don’t even go near the area, as it’s now a confirmed biohazard zone that the city is desperately trying to cover up.
